4. a mid-year move 7A → 7B: the year in two blocks, recorded in full
5. åk 9 whose åk 7 is before SchemaPro: partly unrecorded, no shortfall verdict
6. a backfilled segment is named
7. högstadiet finished June 2024 has no seeded lydelse; finished June 2025 reads bilaga 1
8. åk 1 in HT 2028: the tioårig grundskola, totals only
9. förskoleklass 2027/28 begins in åk 2 in 2028/29: the old cohort, version grade 1, bilaga 1 assumed
10. an old-cohort pupil in new åk 10 in 2029/30 is still in högstadiet
11. hem- och konsumentkunskap over låg- and mellanstadiet in one cell
12. biologi under its own minimum in NO
13. svenska and an SvA group are one cell, summed for the pupil
14. future grades: carried by a plan, or by none
15. grundskola then anpassade grundskolan: the latest form decides the version
16. a school with no timplan and no national codes: notices only, nothing breaks
17. a deleted class leaves its period unrecorded, never zero
18. deactivated and reactivated mid-year: the months away are unrecorded
19. a repeated årskurs, before 2028 and after it
20. an old-cohort pupil at version grade 1 in 2028/29 is not given SFS 2025:729
21. a home class with no årskurs: the grade is unknown, no stage is guessed
